# ByteFlow AI Labs

> AI automation agency. We build lead-to-CRM, WhatsApp AI assistant and order/payment-verification automation for businesses that sell through Facebook and Instagram ads, websites and WhatsApp. Based in Bangladesh, working with clients remotely.

Founder: Md. Siddique Hossain (Founder, AI Systems Architect & Automation Consultant).
Contact: hello@byteflowailabs.com or https://byteflowailabs.com/contact (free 30-minute call).
Typical stack: n8n (self-hosted), WhatsApp Business via Evolution API, OpenRouter LLMs, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Meta Pixel + Conversions API, GA4, Docker on the client's own VPS.

## Core services

- [Lead-to-CRM Automation with WhatsApp Follow-Up](https://byteflowailabs.com/services/lead-to-crm-automation): captures enquiries from ads, website and WhatsApp, replies, scores, routes to the right person and follows up automatically. For real estate, travel, clinics, education and local services.
- [AI WhatsApp Assistant for Support and Booking](https://byteflowailabs.com/services/whatsapp-ai-assistant): answers repeat customer questions, captures details, books appointments or viewings and hands over to a person with full context.
- [Order and Payment Verification Automation](https://byteflowailabs.com/services/order-payment-automation): checks payment screenshots and references against order records, flags duplicates and confirms orders without manual review.
- [WhatsApp chatbot for businesses in Bangladesh](https://byteflowailabs.com/whatsapp-chatbot-bangladesh): Bengali and English WhatsApp chatbot for Bangladeshi businesses — answers customers, books appointments, verifies bKash and Nagad payment screenshots, hands over to staff.
- [All services](https://byteflowailabs.com/services): n8n infrastructure and workflows, WhatsApp automation, AI voice agents, AI lead scoring and CRM automation, Meta Pixel / CAPI tracking, AI content automation.

## Work

- [Portfolio](https://byteflowailabs.com/portfolio): Mustaraka Properties (our own real estate venture in Dhaka: website, listings-aware AI chatbot, WhatsApp viewing-booking agent, n8n lead alerts, admin CRM) and Nova Digital Store (client: 69-node n8n WhatsApp receipt-verification workflow with OCR and duplicate detection).
